How the Book Is Organized 1 General Information Preliminary Test Document: For Axcelis Internal Use Only About this Book How the Book Is Organized General Information This book contains the Drawings and Schematics that may be required to service and maintain the Purion H3and H5 Ion Implantation Systems. These drawings are the latest revision at the time this book was created and will be updated time to time by way of revision. Presently this book contains 4 Volumes and 16 Sections. An attempt was made to map the implanter from the Injector Module to the End Station & EFEM Module. Duplicate Drawings and Schematics (items contained in more than one module) are not added but, are only shown in the first module they are found. The following is a list of the modules contained in the manual. Volume 1 • Section 1 Purion H3 and H5 Specific Drawings • Section 2 (0A94100-03): Injector Module • Section 3 (0A94200-03): Quad/In-Vacuum Scanner & (0A94300-03): Corrector Module • Section 4 (0A97000-03): Facilities Module • Section 5 (0A91000): Operator Interface Module & (0A92200-03): EFEM Module • Section 6 (0A93000-03): Remote Support Equipment Module • Section 7 (0A95000-03): Integration Module Volume 2 • Section 8 (0A92000-03): Process Chamber Module, Room Temperature Implant (RTI) • Section 9 SCARA Arm Components 2.1 High Temperature Implant (HTI) • Section 10 (0A52100-01): Common Process Module • Section 11 SCARA Arm Components 2.0 Low Temperature Implant (LTI) • Section 12 SCARA Arm and Load Lock Components, SiC • Section 13 Process Module - Thin Wafer Components, Load Locks • Section 14 Purion Common End Station Module Drawing Order The drawings are listed in a specific order to make access to associated assembly drawings easier. Section 1 and 2 are in numerical order with the PCBs listed after the System Schematics. Each PCB assembly is followed by the associated schematic if one is available. The other 9 modules is listed per a 12 multi-level BOM of the tool. As an example: 1. 0A90000-03, 0A90000-03 Tool 2. 0A92000-03, Process Module 3. 110122270, Assembly Robot In-Vacuum 2.1 with Arm 4. 110103860, Assembly Vacuum End Effector Adjustable 300MM In this example the top level is the Drawing of the Tool Module (1) that has a second level assembly 0A92000-03, Process Module. The second level has a third level assembly 110122270, Assembly Robot In-Vacuum 2.1 with Arm reporting to 0A92000-03. There is one more assembly 110103860, Assembly Vacuum End Effector Adjustable 300MM reporting to 110122270. Any assemblies reporting to 110103860 would be listed next in the manual. Revisions Revision A, Initial Released, July 2020 Revision B, Updated, Added new sections (SiC and TurboTherm), November 11, 2022 Revision C, Updated, Added new Process Module sections (RTI, HTI, LTI and Thin), November 27, 2024

EPOXY-METAL CASTING PROCESS (LOW-TEMPERATURE CURING): A) MIX RATIO: (PARTS BY WEIGHT) ARALDITE "F" = 98 PARTS ARALDITE W-133 RED = 2 PARTS HARDENER HY-905 = 100 PARTS SILICA FLOUR (400M) = 100 PARTS FLEXIBILIZER DY-040 = 10 PARTS ACCELERATOR DY-061 = 2 PARTS B) MIXING I. III.OUTGAS ARALDITE "F", HARDENER HY-905 AND SILICA FLOUR @ 35$C FOR 3 HOURS (VACUUM 0.5 TORR TO 1.0 TORR). IV. STUFF FIBERGLASS CLOTH INTO THICK EPOXY AREAS WITHIN THE SCAN MAGNET ASSEMBLY (EG. THE REGION BETWEEN THE FIELD CLAMP AND POLES/COIL). II. JUST PRIOR TO IMPREGNATION, OUTGAS CAST-MODULE (MAGNET ASSEMBLY INSIDE MOLD) @ 40$C FOR A MINIMUM OF 12 HOURS (VACUUM @ 0.5 TORR). III. POUR MIX INTO CAST-MODULE AND IMPREGNATE THE MAGNET ASSEMBLY. IV. KEEP CAST-MODULE FULLY COVERED THROUGHOUT THE CURING CYCLE. V. MOVE CAST-MODULE TO THE OVEN (OVEN PROGRAM 3 HOURS @ 60$C, THEN 24 HOURS @ 75$C) VI. AFTER COMPLETION OF HEATING CYCLE, TURN THE OVEN OFF AND LEAVE THE CAST-MODULE IN THE OVEN TO REACH ROOM TEMPERATURE SLOWLY. How the Book Is Organized 1 General Information Preliminary Test Document: For Axcelis Internal Use Only About this Book How the Book Is Organized General Information This book contains the Drawings and Schematics that may be required to service and maintain the Purion H3and H5 Ion Implantation Systems. These drawings are the latest revision at the time this book was created and will be updated time to time by way of revision. Presently this book contains 4 Volumes and 16 Sections. An attempt was made to map the implanter from the Injector Module to the End Station & EFEM Module. Duplicate Drawings and Schematics (items contained in more than one module) are not added but, are only shown in the first module they are found. The following is a list of the modules contained in the manual. Volume 1 • Section 1 Purion H3 and H5 Specific Drawings • Section 2 (0A94100-03): Injector Module • Section 3 (0A94200-03): Quad/In-Vacuum Scanner & (0A94300-03): Corrector Module • Section 4 (0A97000-03): Facilities Module • Section 5 (0A91000): Operator Interface Module & (0A92200-03): EFEM Module • Section 6 (0A93000-03): Remote Support Equipment Module • Section 7 (0A95000-03): Integration Module Volume 2 • Section 8 (0A92000-03): Process Chamber Module, Room Temperature Implant (RTI) • Section 9 SCARA Arm Components 2.1 High Temperature Implant (HTI) • Section 10 (0A52100-01): Common Process Module • Section 11 SCARA Arm Components 2.0 Low Temperature Implant (LTI) • Section 12 SCARA Arm and Load Lock Components, SiC • Section 13 Process Module - Thin Wafer Components, Load Locks • Section 14 Purion Common End Station Module Drawing Order The drawings are listed in a specific order to make access to associated assembly drawings easier. Section 1 and 2 are in numerical order with the PCBs listed after the System Schematics. Each PCB assembly is followed by the associated schematic if one is available. The other 9 modules is listed per a 12 multi-level BOM of the tool. As an example: 1. 0A90000-03, 0A90000-03 Tool 2. 0A92000-03, Process Module 3. 110122270, Assembly Robot In-Vacuum 2.1 with Arm 4. 110103860, Assembly Vacuum End Effector Adjustable 300MM In this example the top level is the Drawing of the Tool Module (1) that has a second level assembly 0A92000-03, Process Module. The second level has a third level assembly 110122270, Assembly Robot In-Vacuum 2.1 with Arm reporting to 0A92000-03. There is one more assembly 110103860, Assembly Vacuum End Effector Adjustable 300MM reporting to 110122270. Any assemblies reporting to 110103860 would be listed next in the manual.
